title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: v1.14.1 reduces the extension download size by approximately 30 MB by removing nine unused walkthrough GIFs, and sharpens the built-in Library Sources walkthrough step with a more realistic example.

highlights.title: ~30 MB VSIX size reduction
highlights.description: Nine orphan GIF files were removed from the extension package, cutting the download and install size by approximately 30 MB with no change to functionality.

highlights.title: Walkthrough step accuracy
highlights.description: The Library Sources step in the built-in walkthrough now uses a coroutines library jar as its example, giving new users a clearer and more realistic introduction to library source navigation.

highlights.title: No behavioral changes
highlights.description: No changes to navigation, commands, settings, or any other user-facing extension behavior since v1.14.0.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Removed nine unused GIF files from the extension package, reducing the VSIX download size by approximately 30 MB.
Updated the Library Sources step in the built-in walkthrough to demonstrate the feature with a coroutines library jar, making the guided example more accurate and realistic for new users.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No changes to extension commands, settings, navigation, or any user-facing behavior since v1.14.0.
